h02-luis-feet.observed_description: Luis (navy T-shirt, rolled khaki trousers) sits on a park bench bent forward, wincing, one hand on each ankle; both bare feet rest side by side on the ground toward the camera and his white sneakers lie beside the bench.
h02-luis-feet.note: Usable: both bare feet and the pain read at 180 px, so 'My feet hurt.' shows two feet. Face matches the 1.2 reference.
